description: Default tracks of `fidetype demo live` (P14-06). Data paths use ${DATA} = $FIDETYPE_DATA (default ~/bci-data). Tracks whose data are missing are skipped with a message.

tracks.title: Implant: attempted speech to text
tracks.subtitle: A person with an implant in the speech area of the brain (participant T15) tries to say each sentence. Each sentence plays at the speed it was spoken.

dataset.name: Brain-to-Text '25, T15 copy-task neural data (Card et al. 2024)

tracks.decoder_label: Our causal GRU-CTC phoneme decoder (M4-12, lookahead 0) + our word decoder with an n-gram LM
tracks.trust_label: Trust config tcfg-e7e8c472f6d9ab33 (M2-19: LTT, alpha 0.05, delta 0.1), held-out val_eval trials
notes: Decisions are the recorded M2-19 run (experiments/2026-11-15-m2-19-trust-retune), replayed with their recorded timing and latency.
The grey preview is the greedy phoneme output of the recorded decoder log-probabilities.
M2-19 found that this config needs the M2-18 commit gate before any real use (it fails the uniform-noise control without it).

tracks.title: Wrist EMG: touch typing to text
tracks.subtitle: A person types on a keyboard while two wristbands record the muscle signals (surface EMG). The decoder guesses each key press.
tracks.decoder_label: P4-01 LDA key classifier (session-calibrated baseline, key accuracy 0.54), beam search without LM
tracks.trust_label: Trust config fitted by `--prepare emg2qwerty` on the first half of the prompts of each session (alpha 0.05)
notes: Research use only: data, streams and this config are CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
This is a weak baseline decoder. The trust layer should offer or withhold almost everything it types.
The P11-01 EMG decoder plugs in here by configuration (kind nts-streams, decoder greedy).

tracks.title: Wrist EMG: continuous decoder (P11-01)
tracks.subtitle: Template: set enabled to true when P11-01 writes NTS files (fidetype.adapters.ctc_logits).

tracks.title: Synthetic decoder (no recording)
tracks.subtitle: Simulated decoder output at six signal levels, two of them with no signal at all. Needs no data.

dataset.name: Synthetic phrases and simulated decoder streams (fidetype.demo, M7-01)

tracks.decoder_label: Small beam search with a character 5-gram LM (fidetype.trust.testing.ReferenceDecoder)
tracks.trust_label: Packaged demo config (Paper 1 recipe, LTT alpha 0.05)
notes: Synthetic data: this is not a recording of a person.
